scope: Explicit path imports with aliases (#load "FILE.coax" as NAME;), per-module declaration scopes and qualified type/procedure/constant/enum-member lookup in the checked Coax graph. Legacy #load graphs are unchanged; visibility (private-by-default modules) is the next child.

new_rules: SU_scan alias form (errors 4 alias syntax, 5 module parameters, 6 package search)

kernels.seeds: bootstrap/sources.{c,h}, parser.c and checker.{c,h} refreshed; coax/build.sh regenerates them byte for byte

native_transport: src/sources.cpp records aliases and refuses E0608-E0611
src/check.cpp passes node scopes, module IDs and aliases to CK_run
src/emit_c.cpp spells colliding private declarations coax_qNt_/coax_qNp_; unique names keep their spelling

covers: colliding V/g/K/E resolve under coax run, native build, emitted C and compile-time #run
Metal scalar kernel binds warm.gain/cool.gain to distinct procedures
unknown alias, ambiguity, missing declaration, proc-as-value, constant assignment and qualified builtin fail at the use
alias rename keeps declaration IDs; same-layout types stay nominally distinct
reexport chains, module parameters, package search, alias without #module and alias conflicts refused
colliding #export_c symbols and library header types refused (E0387)
legacy #load graphs, flat C and same-scope duplicates unchanged

legacy_codegen.pages: 56 of 56 compilable apps/openagents-web/*.coax pages emit byte-identical C (--library); everglade.coax, verse/everglade/guard-decision.coax, verse/hud.coax identical

limits: one alias deep; aliases are not reexported
an unqualified name still binds to a declaration exactly one other scope makes (legacy compatibility)
untyped literal constants are inlined, so their uses are not declaration references
